title: END CARDS: SHORT XP LINE, 32PX TITLE, TILES UNDER THE LOSS, GHOST FEEDBACK BUTTON
why: The critic held the killed, abandoned and abandon-question cards at 3: the xp line explains too much, the tiles sit above the figure, the title competes with the hero, the feedback line has no button shape and a toast shows over the abandon question. Rendering only.
now: End cards show a short xp line, a 32px title, tiles under the loss figure and a bordered feedback button; the abandon question hides the raid feed and its x sits on the title row.

edits.anchor: if((m=/^(\+[\d,]+ XP)( · [\d,]+ of [\d,]+)(<\/span>.*)$/.exec(ln))){ out.push(m[1]+''+m[2]+''+m[3]); continue; }
edits.replacement: // v34.xx (cw-endcards2), the critic on 35 and 60 (3 of 5, P1): "the xp line explains too much: the penalty clause, a total, and the figure twice". Q8, reason in notes/ui/changes.md: the card shows "+65 xp . 50% penalty" (or "+65 xp"); the penalty sentence and the totals stay as hidden text (class ocsr) so nothing that reads the card moves. if((m=/^(\+[\d,]+ XP)(?: (\((\d+)% penalty [^)]*\)))?( · [\d,]+(?: of [\d,]+| XP in all))(<\/span>.*)$/.exec(ln))){ out.push(m[1]+(m[3]?' · '+m[3]+'% penalty':'')+''+(m[2]?' '+m[2]:'')+m[4]+''+m[5]); continue; }

#root #pausebox.asking #pausex{ top:calc(50% - var(--sp-1) * 20 + var(--sp-5) - var(--sp-1)); }   /* v34.xx (cw-endcards2), the critic on 59 (3 of 5): "the x is centred on a different baseline than the title (428 against 444)". 16px lower, on the title row. */
